parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path. The type-alias 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator' in that file is almost certainly a local copy introduced to support the sample app's debug HUD without taking a hard dependency on the DebugPanel package. The other record in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' is the canonical definition. Because one record is explicitly in a sample-app context, the duplication is intentional and consolidation would couple the sample app to production infrastructure.
